title: Top country and data thresholds
path: Reports > User > User attributes > Demographic details
steps: In the Google Merchandise Store property, open Reports > User > User attributes > Demographic details.
Set the date range to the month the app shows, from its first day to its last.
Make sure the table's first column is Country. If it shows another dimension, choose Country from the drop-down at the top of that column.
Sort the table by the Active users column, highest first, and read the country in the first row.

Switch the table's dimension to Age, then to Gender. Each time, open the data quality icon at the top of the report and read its message. A thresholding message says that Google Analytics has applied thresholding to one or more cards in the report.

parts.question: Which country has the most active users in the month? Type its name as GA4 shows it.
With the dimension set to Age or to Gender (either one), does the data quality icon say that thresholding was applied?
Which of these can make GA4 apply data thresholds to a report?
options: Demographic data in the report, such as age or gender
Event data retention set to 2 months
An exploration that covers more than 10 million events
